description.en: Local-first pentest intelligence memory as a native DeepSeek Harness panel: vulnerability board with separate client findings (Android/iOS/desktop), internal operations with per-entity delete, 3D Memory Nebula, assets with editable system names, snapshots, retest, standalone Web Fuzzer with safe raw/JSON/render responses, project and selected-asset export (JSON/CSV/DefectDojo), asset batch export/delete, and mini-program (wxapkg) reversing, plus 22 native agent tools that use the local Cortex SQLite without MCP. Raw local data is shown/exported without masking.
description.zh: 本地优先的渗透测试情报记忆，作为 DeepSeek Harness 原生面板：漏洞看板（含独立 Android/iOS/桌面客户端漏洞）、内网作战（实体逐条删除）、3D 记忆星云、资产库（可编辑系统名）、认知快照、漏洞复测、独立 Web Fuzzer（原始/JSON/安全渲染响应）、项目与选中资产导出（JSON/CSV/DefectDojo）、资产批量导出/删除与小程序逆向（wxapkg 检测/解密/解包/分析），并内置 22 个原生 Agent 工具，直接读写本地 Cortex SQLite，无需 MCP。本地数据按原始值展示与导出，不做脱敏。

description.en: Cortex workbench for DSH: client findings separated from Web findings, internal operations with entity deletion, editable asset system names, the original vulnerability board/assets/Memory Nebula/snapshots/retest/standalone Web Fuzzer/mini-program reversing, project and selected-asset export (JSON/CSV/DefectDojo), asset batch export/delete, raw local data without masking, 22 cortex_* agent tools and an injected usage prompt.
description.zh: DSH 版 Cortex 工作台：客户端漏洞与 Web 漏洞分开、内网作战支持实体删除、资产库支持可编辑系统名，保留原版漏洞看板/资产/记忆星云/快照/复测/独立 Web Fuzzer/小程序逆向，另含项目与选中资产导出（JSON/CSV/DefectDojo）、资产批量导出/删除、本地原始数据不脱敏、22 个 cortex_* Agent 工具与自动注入的使用提示。
